title: The Missing Earring Is Found and the Phool Episode Opens

blocks.text: The Delhi mission comes perilously close to disaster when the court expects a matched pair of ornaments rather than a single gift. Mohan's party concludes that The other earring must be lying somewhere around the spot where the (invading) Chattarsal had died, and by searching there they recover the missing piece before imperial anger can fall on the whole clan.

That recovery transforms anxiety into reward. The gift is completed, favor is restored, and A lease deed for one lakh acres is granted, turning a near catastrophe into a decisive material gain for the community.

The page then pivots into a fresh genealogy by saying, Listen now to the account of (Baba) Phool. The narrative leaves the Delhi court behind and opens the foundational Phulkian story under Guru Hargobind's blessing.
